title: Hybrid Learning and Training Effectiveness at Union Bank of India

instructions.eligibility: During the last 12 months, have you attended a training programme that included both digital or online learning and face-to-face learning? If your answer is No, please do not continue with the questionnaire.
instructions.reference_period: Please answer the statements with reference to one hybrid-training programme attended during the last 12 months.
instructions.confidentiality: Participation is voluntary and confidential. Do not write your name, employee number, customer details, or any confidential Bank information.
instructions.platform_note: In Questions 5-11, "digital learning platform" means Union Vidya where it was used for your selected programme, or another authorised digital platform used for that programme.

questions.text: During the last 12 months, have you attended a training programme that included both digital or online learning and face-to-face learning?
questions.gate_rule: If answer is No, respondent does not continue with the questionnaire.

questions.text: Age group
Length of service in Union Bank of India
Job level
The digital and face-to-face parts of the programme were planned as one connected learning experience.
The digital activities prepared me for the face-to-face sessions.
The face-to-face sessions helped me clarify or apply what I learned through the digital activities.
I could access the digital learning platform used for the programme without much difficulty.
The digital platform was easy for me to navigate while completing the training.
Learning materials on the digital platform were available when I needed them.
I could revisit digital modules or learning materials when I needed revision.
The trainer had good knowledge of the training subject.
The trainer explained the training content clearly.
The trainer explained how the digital and face-to-face activities were connected.
The trainer was able to use the digital tools involved in the programme effectively.
The trainer encouraged employees to ask questions and take part in activities.
The trainer gave feedback that helped me understand or improve my learning.
I stayed attentive during the training activities.
I made a serious effort to understand the training content.
I participated actively in discussions, exercises, or other training activities.
I felt involved in the learning process rather than simply completing required activities.
I asked questions or sought clarification when I did not understand something.
I remained interested in completing the programme.
I understood the main knowledge or skills covered in the programme.
The training gave me knowledge or skills that are useful in my current role.
The content of the programme was relevant to the work I do at the Bank.
I feel capable of using the knowledge or skills taught in the programme.
I have applied learning from the programme in my day-to-day work.
The programme helped me deal with relevant work tasks or problems more effectively.
The programme has improved my confidence in carrying out relevant work responsibilities.

scoring.notes: Construct score = mean of that construct's Likert responses (Q5-30 only). Q1-4 are eligibility/profile fields, excluded from construct scoring.
